messages.content:
Sarunyu has a stick of length 1 with one endpoint marked in red. Every minute, he picks one of his sticks uniformly at random and breaks it into two halves of equal length. Compute the expected length of the stick with the red endpoint after 5 minutes.

Put your final answer within \boxed{}.

message.content:
Let \(L_t\) be the length of the stick containing the red endpoint after \(t\) minutes.

After \(t\) minutes, there are \(t+1\) sticks total, so before minute \(t+1\), the probability of selecting the red stick is

\[
\frac{1}{t+1}.
\]

If the red stick is selected, its length becomes half as large; if it is not selected, its length stays the same. Thus

\[
\mathbb{E}[L_{t+1}\mid L_t]
= \left(1-\frac{1}{t+1}\right)L_t + \frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{t+1}L_t
= \left(1-\frac{1}{2(t+1)}\right)L_t.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\mathbb{E}[L_5]
= \prod_{j=1}^{5}\left(1-\frac{1}{2j}\right)
= \frac12\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac56\cdot\frac78\cdot\frac9{10}.
\]

Compute:

\[
\frac12\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac56\cdot\frac78\cdot\frac9{10}
= \frac{945}{3840}
= \frac{63}{256}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{63}{256}}
\]
